name: Western: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Western look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, classic western film still, wide anamorphic frame, weathered faces, dust-caked leather and denim, sun-bleached timber, hard midday sun or golden-hour backlight, ochre and rust palette, long shadows, heat haze, slow wide establishing pans, long holds on faces, dust and tumbleweed drifting, riders small against the horizon
negative_prompt: modern vehicles, power lines, clean clothes, neon, lush green forest, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
